# Gennial Studio

> AI-native studio + lab building vertical microdramas and viral content at the speed of culture. The Next Big Shift.

Gennial Studio is an IA STUDIO+LAB producing vertical microdramas and short-form viral content. Founded by Adrian Garelik (serial tech & entertainment entrepreneur, founder of Flixxo, credits with Netflix, HBO and Disney).
